# Che Bello

> Italian Restaurant in Bloomington, Indiana. Truffle fries, seafood spaghetti, lobster ravioli and an espresso martini, under string lights.

- Phone: (812) 964-4035

- Areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Spencer, Nashville, Martinsville
- Offers: Pasta and risotto; Steaks and salmon; Pizza, panini and plates
- Rating: 3.5 from 311 Google reviews
